topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the learning objectives regarding cancer evolution, stem cell biology, and the role of the microenvironment.

topics.label: Clonal Evolution and Epigenetic Dynamics in Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations confer selective advantages that drive clonal tumor evolution.

topics.label: Stem Cell Hierarchies and the Cell of Origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the cancer stem cell model and investigate how tissue hierarchies and specific cells of origin dictate tumor initiation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental stimuli, local inflammation, and supportive stroma act as essential permissive factors for tumor outgrowth.

topics.label: Profiling Technologies and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics present advanced molecular methods for mapping tumor-microenvironment interactions and synthesize the multifactorial evolutionary model of cancer progression.

topics.label: Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing remarks and a preview of the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
